name: Inquisitor Camelback Inquisitor
body:
Camelback inquisitors take asceticism to a new level, training their bodies to function in situations of extreme adversity. Deprivation, pain, blistering heat, and lack of nourishment are all states that a camelback inquisitor has conditioned their body to overcome. Indeed, the name camelback inquisitor comes from the ability to subsist on extremely little water, much like a camel.

Camelbacks are unrelenting in their crusade against adversaries of the faith—they’ll travel to the remotest, most inhospitable regions (where few are willing to follow) to track down a foe and obtain justice.

A camelback inquisitor has the following class features.

Defensive Instinct (Ex)

At 1st level, when unarmored, not using a shield, unencumbered, and conscious, the camelback adds their Wisdom bonus (if any) to their AC and CMD. If a camelback is wearing nonmetal armor or using a nonmetal shield, they instead add 1/2 their Wisdom bonus to their AC. In addition, a camelback gains a +1 bonus to their AC and CMD at 4th level. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 camelback levels thereafter (up to a maximum of +5 at 20th level).

These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks and when the camelback is flat-footed. The camelback loses these bonuses when they are immobilized or helpless. For the purpose of determining when to add the +1 bonus to AC and CMD, an inquisitor that multiclasses with a monk or a shifter treats their monk and shifter levels as inquisitor levels.

This replaces stern gaze.

Resilient Magic (Sp)

At 3rd level, a camelback gains 1 resilient spell for every level spell they can cast. A camelback can cast their resilient spells as spell-like abilities once each per day with a target of you (self) only.

Resilient Spells: endure elements (1st), restoration, lesser (2nd), protection from energy (3rd), restoration (4th), spell resistance (5th), cleanse (6th).

This replaces solo tactics.

Ascetic Practice (Ex)

At 3rd level, a camelback gains their first ascetic practice. At subsequent levels (6, 9, 12, 15, and 18), they gain their choice of another ascetic practice. At each level a camelback gains an ascetic practice, they can choose from the list below. A camelback can’t choose the same ascetic practice twice unless noted in the description.

Accelerated Rejuvenation: You gain all the benefits of 8 hours of sleep in just 2 hours.
Firewalker: You have developed Resist fire 5 from your practice of walking over hot coals.
Magical Reserves: You gain 1 extra spell slot per day which you can use to cast any spell that you are capable of casting.
Metabolic Manipulation: You know how to conserve water in your cells and how to slow your metabolic rate. You can go 3 times as long without food and water before succumbing to starvation or thirst (see the previous section: Starvation and Thirst).
Overcome Hurdle: You can overcome biological maladies and improve your physical prowess with sheer willpower. You add your Wisdom modifier as a bonus on Fortitude and Reflex saving throws.
Slow Respiration: You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour per point of Constitution.
Unflagging: You gain the bonus feat Diehard, Endurance, Great Fortitude, or Iron Will (your choice). You must meet each feat’s prerequisites. You can select this practice multiple times, choosing a different feat each time.
Unrelenting: You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

This replaces all teamwork feats.

Lost Atlanteans, Copyright 2024, Bloodstone Press; author Beth Jones
